title: Zhuo Bi, the Gatekeeper - Location, Tactics & Rewards
description: Zhuo Bi, the Gatekeeper in Phantom Blade Zero - where the fight happens, what it drops, and how its attack patterns are countered, including the red and blue flash tells.
keyword: Zhuo Bi, the Gatekeeper phantom blade zero boss

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Zhuo Bi, the Gatekeeper is a story encounter in Village of Lu, found at Village of Lu approach. Beating it yields Bastion.

sections.title: Where to Find the Zhuo Bi, the Gatekeeper
sections.content:
Location: Village of Lu approach.

Appears in: Village of Lu.

sections.title: Weaknesses and Counters
sections.content:
There is no weakness table for this fight because there is no damage-type system to fill one in: nothing here resists, absorbs or is immune to anything, and a chart that says otherwise has been inferred from how the boss looks. Read the fight by attack colour instead - red must be dodged, blue must be deflected, purple means it has just parried you and a counter is already coming. The full explanation is on the combat system.

It is mandatory, so it cannot be walked past - the fight is worth learning rather than trying to out-level.

sections.title: How to Beat the Zhuo Bi, the Gatekeeper
sections.content:
What works

  • Strong guard-breaking attacks are the intended answer - chip damage takes too long.

sections.title: Status
sections.content: No. 16 of 60 in the progression order, in Village of Lu. Before it: Yucong, the Twisted Puppet (No. 34). After it: Master Bi Yuan. The roster by region is on the boss list, and the fights that can be lost by leaving a region early are on the order page. Location and drops come from the shipped game; patch 1.0302256 is the most recent change to any boss behaviour and it touched only Hua.
